data.long_meaning: Mahes is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Mahesh, also known as Shiva. The name Mahes signifies 'Lord of Great Power'. Shiva is the god of destruction and transformation, and is one of the primary deities in Hinduism. The name Mahes carries the meaning “Lord of Great Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahes usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of great power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
